title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Center Music Hall on 1972-11-15
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Miller soundboard captures a high‑energy 1972 show with smoking Bird Song, a monster 30‑minute Playing in the Band, and stellar performances of Candyman, Brokedown Palace and Cumberland Blues.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑remastered soundboard delivers pristine clarity – the mix is tight, instruments sit well together and even the occasional flat spot (China > Rider) is a minor blip. Musically the night is a fire‑cracker: Bird Song soars, the half‑hour Playing in the Band is a centerpiece, and classics like Candyman, Box of Rain, Brokedown Palace and Cumberland Blues are all delivered with raw 1972 energy. Overall the performance is rated among the band’s best of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (over 30) are 4‑5 stars and praise both the audio fidelity and the musical performance; only a handful of low‑rated or off‑topic comments exist, leading to a strong positive consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller’s remaster is described as crystal‑clear and top‑notch; the mix balances all members well. Minor issues noted: a slightly flat China > Rider transition and a minimal Sugar Magnolia, but overall superb clarity and low noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two energetic sets bookended by a monster PITB; the first set builds with Bird Song and Candyman, while the second set peaks with the extended Playing in the Band before closing strong with Big Railroad Blues and Bobby McGee.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his pre‑effects Strat tone, loopy solo on Playing in the Band, and overall inventive guitar work throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as relaxed and well‑sung on Box of Rain; occasional “tight” bass foundation noted but no major criticism.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for inventive rhythm guitar, strong vocal harmonies, and standout moments on Bobby McGee and other cuts.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s jazz‑groove contribution to the long Playing in the Band segment is singled out as a highlight; overall keyboard work praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy (Kreutzmann) mentioned as part of an A+ rhythm section, providing solid drive behind the extended jams.
